🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). SPY in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -0.42%) ↓ falling and TLT in BELOW TREND (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -5.25%) ↓ falling confirm mixed weakness while VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +1.75% | 1M: -4.96%) ↑ rising flags near-term volatility.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress showing deterioration: HYG in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -2.45%) ↓ falling and LQD in BELOW TREND (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -3.30%) ↓ falling. Fear signals mixed with VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +1.75% | 1M: -4.96%) ↑ rising and broad equity softness (SPY BELOW TREND 1W: -1.19% | 1M: -0.42%) ↓ falling.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Tightening bias: TLT in BELOW TREND (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -5.25%) ↓ falling and corporate bonds LQD/HYG BELOW TREND show tighter financial conditions. Gold GLD in BELOW TREND (1W: -4.29% | 1M: -6.36%) ↓ falling reinforces risk-off asset weakness.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Leadership extremely narrow: Healthcare in RECOVERY (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.96%) is the lone positive sector while XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.87%) ↓ falling and XLB in BELOW TREND (1W: -2.83% | 1M: -7.25%) ↓ falling show weakness. Style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US equities soft with SPY in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -0.42%) ↓ falling while Emerging Markets EEM in CORRECTION (1W: -2.46% | 1M: +0.39%) ↓ falling and China FXI in BELOW TREND (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -4.65%) ↓ falling underperform. Global risk bias is uneven, not synchronized.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative flows mixed: IBIT in CORRECTION (1W: -3.07% | 1M: +7.81%) ↓ falling and ARKK in CORRECTION (1W: -2.36% | 1M: +5.75%) ↓ falling show month-to-date gains but weekly weakness. Small caps IWM in BELOW TREND (1W: -2.86% | 1M: -5.41%) ↓ falling signal risk aversion among higher beta names.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Bifurcation across commodities with BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) ↑ rising while CPER in CORRECTION (1W: -3.62% | 1M: +0.66%) ↓ falling and GLD in BELOW TREND (1W: -4.29% | 1M: -6.36%) ↓ falling lagging. Commodities leadership is narrow and concentrated in oil/brent.

8. Energy Trend?
Dispersion within energy: BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) ↑ rising but XLE in BELOW TREND (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -1.24%) ↓ falling and UNG in CORRECTION (1W: -4.70% | 1M: +0.19%) ↓ falling show equity/commodity divergence. Watch crude strength versus energy equities for flow shifts.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
MAJOR Divergence present: multiple CORRECTION signals across QQQ (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION, XLK (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.87%) CORRECTION and IBIT (1W: -3.07% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION indicate 1W weakness vs 1M gains and suppress strong regime conviction. Confirmed strength is limited to a few commodity ETFs (BNO ABOVE TREND 1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) ↑ rising.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Reduce exposure to small-cap and materials risk: IWM in BELOW TREND (1W: -2.86% | 1M: -5.41%) ↓ falling and XLB in BELOW TREND (1W: -2.83% | 1M: -7.25%) ↓ falling. Favor commodity exposure showing strength like BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) ↑ rising and monitor speculative tilts in IBIT (1W: -3.07% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Healthcare in RECOVERY (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.96%) and Energy/Brent via BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) ↑ rising. BEARISH: Materials XLB in BELOW TREND (1W: -2.83% | 1M: -7.25%) ↓ falling and Metals SLV in BELOW TREND (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -7.56%) ↓ falling.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO in ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) ↑ rising and USO in CORRECTION (1W: -0.51% | 1M: +10.52%) ↓ falling for crude-related strength. BEARISH: SLV in BELOW TREND (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -7.56%) ↓ falling and URA in BELOW TREND (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -12.14%) ↓ falling.

13. Key Levels?
Watch VXX in RECOVERY (1W: +1.75% | 1M: -4.96%) ↑ rising — a sustained move higher would signal renewed risk-off. Monitor HYG/LQD (HYG 1W: -1.67% | 1M: -2.45% ↓ falling; LQD 1W: -2.55% | 1M: -3.30% ↓ falling) as a credit-health trigger and SPY in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -0.42%) for equity risk tilt.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak); confirmed by SPY in BELOW TREND (1W: -1.19% | 1M: -0.42%) ↓ falling and TLT in BELOW TREND (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -5.25%) ↓ falling. Commodity proxies are showing relative strength (BNO ABOVE TREND 1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) while major divergence across CORRECTION signals in XLK (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +4.87%), QQQ (1W: -1.27% | 1M: +3.11%) and IBIT (1W: -3.07% | 1M: +7.81%) is the key risk to monitor (VXX in RECOVERY 1W: +1.75% | 1M: -4.96% ↑ rising).
